reply: That's correct. CORS enforcement happens in the browser, not the server. The server sends the response normally; the browser reads the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header and blocks JavaScript from accessing the response body if the origin doesn't match. curl has no CORS check, so it reads the full response regardless of what headers came back.
